question: Your application response says, "I organised a weekend clean-up with twelve volunteers and split them into three teams. Each team had a leader and a list of streets. We finished by two and collected forty bags." Describe a time fairness changed your plan. What did you choose?

answer.text: I kept the original plan so we could finish on time.
It worked, but I did not ask the others how the change affected them.

suggestions.question: What did you do when you realised the others had not been asked?
suggestions.why: The answer says the others were not asked, but gives no example of how their views were considered afterward.

evidence.quote: I did not ask the others how the change affected them.
